summary: For S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, Ceph, MinIO) set METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_TARGET=s3 plus METRICS_UTILITY_BUCKET_NAME, BUCKET_ENDPOINT, BUCKET_REGION (AWS) and BUCKET_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET_KEY.
questions: How do I store metrics-utility reports in S3?
Can metrics-utility use MinIO or Ceph?

answer_card.title: metrics-utility to S3 storage
answer_card.answer_md:
```sh
export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_TARGET=s3
export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_PATH=path_to_data_and_reports/
export METRICS_UTILITY_BUCKET_NAME=metricsutilitys3
export METRICS_UTILITY_BUCKET_ENDPOINT="https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
export METRICS_UTILITY_BUCKET_REGION="us-east-1"   # AWS only
export METRICS_UTILITY_BUCKET_ACCESS_KEY=<access_key>
export METRICS_UTILITY_BUCKET_SECRET_KEY=<secret_key>
```
Works for AWS S3, Ceph Object storage and MinIO.
